description: The release supports analysis of non-migrating bars and dune dynamics along a 20-kilometre Waal River reach in the Netherlands. The native description identifies longitudinal training dams built to maintain navigation depth during low water and reduce flood risk. Data cover two-year periods before and after construction, within the custom 2011 to 2018 coverage. Coverage: a 20-kilometre Waal River reach in the Netherlands, with custom coverage from 2011 to 2018. Format and access: media types: application/pdf, application/vnd.google-earth.kml+xml, application/x-gzip, application/zip. Public native metadata identifies the deposit. Licence: CC-BY-4.0. File access and cost remain unknown. Caveats: Wageningen University provides the release in the RiverCare collection. Native keywords identify bed level, discharge, water level, multibeam observations and roughness. Exact fields, sampling, survey resolution and uncertainty are unstated. Before and after are research comparisons, not a claim that these observations independently prove dam effects.
